title: No weekly offs, leave: Mysuru woman dies by suicide, names manager in death note
content: In a heartbreaking event in Mysuru, a woman ended her life after allegedly enduring harassment from her supervisor. She left behind a note that accused her manager of coercing her into making admissions of error and intimidating her about job security. A dedicated worker at a marketing firm for three years, her husband noted that she had been raising concerns about her manager’s behavior for the last month.

title: 'It was a complete lie': Babar refused Pathan interview? Here's what happened
content: Former India all-rounder Irfan Pathan recalled how fake news spread during the 2023 ODI World Cup after a Pakistani media outlet falsely claimed Babar Azam refused him an interview. Pathan said his face was photoshopped onto a Bangladeshi reporter’s image. He highlighted how such false stories gain millions of views, while recalling his successful international and IPL career.

title: Person-to-person transactions to remain free: Govt clarifies no charges for UPI users
content: In a press release, the Ministry of Finance has said that users will not be charged for making UPI payments, and all Person-to-Person (P2P) transactions will continue to remain free. It said that if a Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) is introduced in the future, it will apply only to a limited category of merchant transactions above a specified threshold.

title: Elon Musk says Starship Flight 13 recovery ‘not looking good’ after splashdown
content: SpaceX's Starship recovery is struggling against the tumultuous waters of the Indian Ocean, with Elon Musk admitting the situation appears grim. Despite these difficulties, engineers managed to capture invaluable images of essential spacecraft components. This visual data is expected to contribute significantly to enhancements in Starship design and its reusability. Notably, the mission marked SpaceX's most successful Starship test flight to date.

title: Lionel Messi’s father Jorge Messi dies in Argentina after long illness
content: He was a key figure in Lionel Messi's career and remained involved from his son's early days as a footballer through his rise to the top of the sport. Jorge represented Messi in negotiations with clubs and commercial companies and helped build the business setup around the Argentine footballer.

title: Michael Dell’s son’s startup offers $695 alternative to costly home generators
content: Zach Dell's Base Power is installing home battery systems across America.  These systems offer backup power and reduce electricity bills for customers.  The company aims to replace expensive gas generators with its innovative technology.  Base Power is rapidly expanding its operations and customer base nationwide.  This startup is valued at thirteen billion dollars after significant funding.

title: Teen leaves MP home, travels to Mumbai seeking role in Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
content: A 16-year-old boy from Madhya Pradesh traveled to Mumbai seeking an acting career. He left home for school and boarded multiple trains, reaching the city on August 7. Police found the boy alone in Film City and contacted his worried parents. His father is now traveling to Mumbai to bring his son safely home. The minor was found unharmed and is being kept safe at the police station.

title: 2-year-old sister is perfect bone marrow match for Utah girl with severe aplastic anemia
content: Emma Meline, a young girl diagnosed with severe aplastic anemia right before Christmas, found hope in her little sister Lucy. At only two years old, Lucy bravely became a bone marrow donor, granting Emma the chance for a life-saving transplant. After a challenging journey, Emma celebrated her fifth birthday at home, marking a remarkable recovery. This profound experience deepened the unbreakable bond between the two sisters.

title: Mark Zuckerberg gave an update on ‘Meta's 4 am layoff email’ to employees
content: Meta's CEO Mark Zuckerberg addressed the recent layoffs alongside substantial investments in artificial intelligence. Despite reporting impressive revenue growth, the surge in expenses, particularly from severance and legal fees, negatively influenced the second quarter's operating income. The company is committed to advancing its AI infrastructure to pave the way for future innovations and anticipates a reduced headcount due to the layoffs.

title: LeBron James’ wife Savannah reveals why Hermès saleswoman turned her away
content: Savannah James opened up about an alleged Hermès shopping dispute in Italy, claiming a saleswoman was fired after she and April McDaniel were reportedly turned away despite having an appointment. The friends later described how the store addressed the situation. Savannah also discussed marriage, motherhood and life alongside LeBron James, stressing the importance of staying grounded, authentic and invested in a relationship despite the pressure of public life.

title: Hulk Hogan’s son Nick shares family update a year after WWE legend’s death
content: Hulk Hogan's son Nick discusses family coping one year after his father's passing.  The family remains supportive and close, honoring the wrestling icon's memory.  Nick is now leading several businesses connected to his father's famous name.  They celebrated Hulk Hogan Day and continue their strong relationship with WWE.  The family is focused on making Hulk Hogan proud through their ongoing projects.

title: Bihar should withdraw alcohol ban as it failed to curb crimes against women: Report
content: A research paper suggests Bihar should withdraw its alcohol prohibition policy. The ban has not reduced crimes against women, and illicit liquor trade has increased. Restoring liquor excise duty could boost state revenues by fifteen percent. The paper also identified education, health, and jobs as key development priorities. Bihar's development strategy should focus on these interconnected areas for progress.

title: Gurgaon, Delhi under water: 10 videos that capture rain chaos
content: Delhi and Gurgaon faced chaos on Friday due to heavy rainfall that led to extensive waterlogging and blocked roads across the National Capital Region. The Delhi-Gurgaon Expressway witnessed severe traffic congestion, with parts underwater. In light of the conditions, various businesses implemented remote work policies, and educational institutions declared holidays. The India Meteorological Department had also issued a red alert for the region, warning residents of potential hazards.

title: Kavach: What makes Indian Railways indigenous world-class tech special
content: Indian Railways is prioritising Kavach deployment on high-density and highly used network routes, which carry nearly 96% of railway traffic. Now, the next-generation Kavach 5.0 is being developed for suburban rail operations with an aim to support higher train frequencies.

title: Too far, too late: Why pregnant women are still dying en route to care
content: In rural India, pregnant women encounter daunting obstacles when trying to obtain urgent medical care. Inaccessible roads and a lack of ambulances hinder emergency response in these remote areas. Additionally, the scarcity of specialist doctors exacerbates potentially life-threatening obstetric situations. These systemic issues often result in tragic outcomes for mothers and infants alike. Therefore, enhancing healthcare facilities in rural regions is essential to safeguard lives.

title: Why Devdutt Padikkal's fluent ton allows India to breathe easy
content: With Sai Sudharsan all but ruled out of the Sri Lanka series, Devdutt Padikkal seized his chance, scoring a fluent 142 at Colombo’s Nondescript Cricket Club during the warm-up fixture. Displaying assured footwork, confidence against both spin and pace, and solid technique, Padikkal’s performance underscores his readiness for India’s No. 3 spot.

title: Goa's 'anywhere registration' reform for property documents: What it means
content: Goa has introduced a revolutionary property registration system known as 'Anywhere Registration within the District'. This initiative facilitates the registration of property documents at any Sub-Registrar Office within a district, providing buyers and sellers with the flexibility to select offices with earlier appointment slots. Consequently, this reform aims to alleviate congestion and enhance the efficiency of public services through technology-driven solutions.

title: Jason Sanjay reveals Ajith’s special message before 'Sigma' debut
content: Jason Sanjay gears up for his directorial debut with the film 'Sigma', receiving unwavering support from actor Ajith Kumar. Suresh Chandra, Ajith’s manager, steps in to oversee the film’s promotional efforts. Sanjay shared Ajith's valuable advice on reaching out for assistance in the film industry, showcasing the positive evolution of relationships amidst previous competitions.

title: ‘Last time, we failed’: Masked men return to advocate’s house, loot over Rs 3 crore
content: A brazen robbery took place when four masked intruders stormed the home of a senior advocate, threatening him with guns. They escaped with a substantial amount of cash, jewelry worth millions, and a licensed revolver. This residence had already been targeted before. The police are actively investigating by checking city CCTV footage, and security has been intensified around the advocate's dwelling.

title: 'Share data on river waters': India, China hold 'frank' border talks
content: India and China participated in candid discussions regarding border conditions, taking stock of the current landscape along the Line of Actual Control. New Delhi highlighted the necessity of maintaining peace for the advancement of their bilateral relationship. Furthermore, India sought an expedited meeting on the expert committee for trans-border rivers amidst China's unveiling of a significant dam project upstream.

title: Supriya Sule opposes FCRA Bill, urges Centre to withdraw it or send it to JPC
content: Supriya Sule opposes the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026, in its current form. She urges the government to withdraw the proposed legislation or send it to a Joint Parliamentary Committee. Foreign funding should not be viewed with automatic suspicion, she stated during her remarks. Sule also commented on youth protests and disputes over political party symbols. The NCP (SP) leader awaits a hearing on the party's legal battle.

title: ‘Kill my husband or I will’: Man uncovers wife’s chats with lover plotting his murder
content: In a shocking turn of events, a husband has alerted the police about his wife's alleged affair and a potential murder plot. He provided screenshots revealing discussions about orchestrating his murder to resemble a fatal road accident. The police are currently examining the digital evidence's credibility, as both the wife and her accomplice have fled, igniting a manhunt.

title: Toxic trailer out: Yash delivers raw action in Geetu Mohandas' dark gangster drama
content: The trailer for Yash's highly anticipated film 'Toxic' has been released.  This action-packed movie promises a dark and stylish gangster drama.  It features intense action sequences and a romantic storyline.  The film is set against Goa's drug trade and mafia networks.  'Toxic' is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on August 26.

title: From training in dry ponds with wooden javelin to following Chopra's trail: Rise of Ashish
content: Ashish secured the second spot in the men's javelin final with a best effort of 74.09 metres, which came in his third attempt. His performance earned India a podium finish at the global junior event. It is the first time India have won a medal in javelin throw at the Junior World Championships since Neeraj Chopra's monster 86.48m showing in 2016.

title: Houston man’s solo trash cleanups grow into 100-volunteer movement
content: A Houston resident's initiative to clean up neglected areas has blossomed into a vibrant volunteer movement. With one hundred dedicated individuals now on board, their mission is to remove illegally dumped waste. Collaborating with local organizations and harnessing the power of social media, city officials and law enforcement are boosting efforts to tackle this pressing issue, ultimately enhancing the community's aesthetics and the well-being of its residents.

title: 'Which freedom fighter got most severe punishment?' Kerala probes Savarkar quiz
content: A school quiz question in Kerala has ignited a political controversy. The question asked about the freedom fighter receiving the most severe British punishment. General education minister N Samsudheen ordered an inquiry into the unauthorized quiz. Opposition parties accused the government of promoting a Sangh Parivar agenda. Officials are investigating who prepared and conducted the quiz.

title: Chinese grandmother, 71, learns to swim after retirement and saves man
content: A 71-year-old Chinese woman, Liu Defang, saved a man's life after he fell into a river. She had learned to swim only a few years after her retirement from work. Liu bravely entered the water with a lifebuoy to reach the struggling individual. Surveillance footage later revealed her identity, drawing praise from social media users. Her courageous act highlights the value of learning new skills at any age.

title: 'End this war': Senate Democrats turn up heat on Trump, seek end to Iran hostilities
content: Democrats introduced a resolution to end unauthorized US military involvement against Iran. Senator John Hickenlooper leads the effort, citing constitutional war powers. This move escalates a congressional challenge to President Donald Trump's handling of the conflict. Military leaders privately advise seeking an off-ramp from ongoing air operations. President Trump expresses confidence that the confrontation could end soon.

title: ‘Political drama': DMK skips TVK govt's all-party MP meet on Delimitation Bill
content: The DMK party has officially declared it will not participate in a consultation regarding the delimitation of parliamentary constituencies. Kanimozhi Karunanidhi labeled the meeting organized by the state government as mere political theater. She reiterated the DMK's consistent position on delimitation and called for constitutional changes to uphold the representation of southern states. Additionally, the DMK urged the government to resolve the ongoing Mekedatu dam and Cauvery water disputes.

title: Law grad jumps to death from 13th floor in Bandra after women ‘threatened’ to frame him
content: Police registered a case of abetment of suicide against two women recently. A 24-year-old law graduate died after jumping from his apartment. The women had allegedly threatened to frame him in a police case. This caused the young man significant stress and anxiety. His mother approached Kherwadi Police after the tragic incident.

title: Colorado teen gets $15,000 piano from stranger, releases debut album
content: Colorado teenager Jude Kofie has released his debut album, showcasing his piano skills. He taught himself to play the piano by ear at age ten. A generous piano tuner gifted him a valuable instrument and professional lessons. His album features diverse musical styles, including jazz and gospel influences. This release marks a significant milestone in his developing musical career.

title: Kansas bans student phones, earbuds and smartwatches for entire school day
content: Many states are banning smartphones in schools due to growing distractions and health concerns.  Some districts now restrict student phone access from morning bell to afternoon dismissal.  Parents are increasingly supporting these bans, citing research and developmental appropriateness.  Concerns also focus on excessive screen time and inappropriate content accessed on school devices.  Schools are now reviewing technology policies and limiting device usage during non-instructional periods.

title: Congress lost the millennials. Can it win over Gen Z?
content: Rahul Gandhi is focusing on forging a bond with the youth ahead of the 2029 elections, recognizing that Gen Z will be a key voting bloc.
